results.title: Temperature monitoring described generically, no specifics on alerting or compliance automation
results.closest_fact_claim: The facility uses a front-end iSCM platform linked to customer ERP systems, a WMS for cargo movements, and a temperature monitoring and tracking system, though no specifics on deviation-alert speed or automated compliance reporting are given.

results.title: Multiple parallel compliance regimes in one facility, no stated unified audit trail
results.closest_fact_claim: The facility holds six separate certifications -- ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO22000, ISO22339, ISO45000, and HACCP -- and maintains separate storage for Halal and non-Halal products alongside an on-site AVA (food safety authority) Inspection Room.
